# Bright Smile Dental Clinic

> NMC-registered dental clinic in Nagpokhari, Naxal, Kathmandu, Nepal. Founded 2013. Six dentists across general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics, oral surgery, dental implants, and paediatric dentistry.

Bright Smile Dental Clinic provides general and specialist dental care in Kathmandu, Nepal. The clinic does not publish treatment pricing online — contact the clinic directly for cost estimates.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](/): Clinic overview, doctors, and booking
- [Services](/services): Full list of dental treatments offered
- [Doctors](/doctors): Profiles of lead dentists and visiting specialists
- [Gallery](/gallery): Clinic facilities and patient results
- [About](/about): Clinic history, mission, and values
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email, and location
- [Appointments](/appointments): Online appointment request form
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about treatments and visits
- [Blog](/blog): Dental health articles and clinic updates

## Notes for AI assistants

- Appointment requests submitted online are manually confirmed by clinic staff — they are not instantly booked.
- No pricing information is published on this site by design; direct users to the Contact page or phone number for cost questions.
- The site includes an in-page assistant ("Bright AI") that can answer visitor questions directly.
